name: Cocoa bean, wet (with pulp, before fermentation)
source: Fresh bean-and-mucilage fraction removed from the pod: illustrative proximate (per kg) water 700 g (dominated by the sugary mucilage pulp), protein 40 g, fat 130 g (bean cotyledon fat), carbohydrate 110 g (pulp sugars), ash 20 g.
notes: Fermentation and drying (origin/cocoa.ts) are modelled as real, staged moisture loss from this starting point down to cocoa-bean-dried's target moisture, plus a small aerobic-respiration CO2 loss from pulp sugar metabolism — both balanced postings, not composition-file changes. Standard elemental conversion factors as wheat-grain.json.
